'''1996 Corellia Regionals (Chillicothe)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Corellia region. Its winner earned a place at the World Championship.<ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Greg Hefner]] of Louisville, Kentucky won it.<ref name="dec96" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Corellia B)
* '''Date:''' 26 October 1996
* '''Site:''' Chillicothe, Ohio
